title: Tamales Colorados
description: Tamales Colorados is a dish from Guatemala prepared with masa harina, chicken thigh, tomato, achiote paste. This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used. Banana leaves are used for Guatemalan red tamales, as in many traditional regional versions.

steps.instruction: Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Chop the vegetables as needed. Sauté the listed ingredients over medium heat, stirring, for about 10 minutes until softened and aromatic.
Place a portion of prepared filling on each leaf or wrapper, tuck in the sides and roll tightly into neat parcels.
Steam the already prepared parcels or mixture over gently boiling water for approximately 75 minutes, until fully cooked or set.
